summary: LocalActivity retry after backoff fails with payload converter error when the backoff timer fires and workflow task resumes. Users using encryption and custom context headers experience task failure.
userImpact: Users cannot successfully retry failed local activities with encrypted payloads and custom context headers, causing workflow failures.
rootCause: Payload converter throws an error during local activity re-attempt after backoff timer fires, indicating incompatibility in payload handling during retry.
keyQuote: After the Timer fires, on WorkflowTask started- it results in attempt to run LocalActivity - however the payload converter throws the below error
